limitations: Selected running-text checks support editorial decisions. No full verse-by-verse Greek collation, full apparatus examination, Göttingen/Wevers collation or independent specialist certification was completed. Earlier study-note verification statements describe historical work and were not adopted as new claims.
benchmark: Genesis 1–11: all 299 existing verse units aligned with the accepted rendering in Bespoke Saints English (1).pdf. This is exact benchmark alignment, not a newly established critical text.
